row: The Radical Massage Therapist- Freedom, No BS

FREE Massage Practice Checklist 👇

Hi, I’m Krista — I’m here to help massage therapists recognize their career is a golden goose that gives them freedom, flexibility, financial success, and fun (even if they don’t love massage itself).

As a Registered Massage Therapist, clinic owner, podcast host, and coach, I bridge the gap between real talk confessions about this career and practical coaching that helps therapists build sustainable practices without the BS.

I run an education + coaching hub over at www.theradicalrmt.com for massage therapists who are tired of the industry lies and want to design a practice that actually works for their life — in a way that’s radical, honest, and fun.

I especially love connecting with massage therapists who feel stuck, frustrated, or guilty for not being “passionate enough,” but are ready to reclaim their freedom and build a career that supports the lifestyle they actually want.

Is that you? Let’s connect!

💌 krista@theradicalrmt.com
